name: screenshots
//: The terminal screenshots: the capture scripts, fixture and font, CI's freeze installer, and the journeys of the pre-push visual guard (git-hooks), which drives these capture scripts. The capture renders through freeze, so it is left to the Visual docs workflow; lint-sh and test are offline and in the gate tiers.

test.//: The guard's offline script journeys and the demo GIF's outcome drift check. Cached: its inputs are every file they read or run, and (^default) the llmlint sources whose Outcome the drift check reads.

capture.//: Needs freeze (not a gate tool), so it runs only in the Visual docs workflow and the local pre-push guard; `just screenshots` runs it.

commands: cargo build --release --locked -p llmlint -p llmlint-mock-oneharness --bin llmlint --bin llmlint-mock-oneharness
